register: # SOURCES: ABB EV-meter 'Modbus map' 9AKK107991A9529 Rev B (same A/B-series layout: 0x5B00 voltage, 0x5B0C current, 0x5B14 power, 0x5B2C frequency, 0x5B3A power factor, 0x5000/0x5004 energy) + ABB B21/B23/B24 energy-register offsets as listed by aggsoft + Quantum Bit Solutions + Victron dbus-modbus-client abb.py (validated on B21/B23/B24 hardware).

# NOT FROM A VENDOR B-SERIES DOCUMENT: ABB's B-series product manual 2CDC512084D0101 chapter 4 could not be retrieved. Rows marked INFERRED were placed by layout contiguity (reactive 0x5B1C, apparent 0x5B24 fill the gap to frequency 0x5B2C) and should be confirmed on a meter.

# SERIAL: Modbus RTU RS-485, FC03 only. ABB EV-meter doc lists 9600 8E1 default; B-series factory baud/parity not confirmed - set on meter menu, verify parity (ABB typically ships EVEN). Slave id default 1. Unsupported registers return FFFF.../7FFF... instead of an exception.
# SCOPE: single-phase (B21) so L1 only. B23/B24 add L2/L3 at 0x5B02/0x5B04 (V), 0x5B0E/0x5B10 (A), 0x5B18/0x5B1A (W), 0x5B3C/0x5B3D (PF), 0x5460+ per-phase energy.

note: 0x5170; B21 tariff counter (0 when tariff unused)
0x5174; B21 tariff counter (0 when tariff unused)
0x5178; B21 tariff counter (0 when tariff unused)
0x517C; B21 tariff counter (0 when tariff unused)
0x5B3A; ABB EV-meter doc shows unsigned 0-1; read as signed so a negative PF (if the meter reports one) is not misread
0x8A13; 64 flags, bit0 = EE (EEPROM) error per ABB EV-meter doc
